<script>
  document.getElementById('yr').textContent = new Date().getFullYear();
  const burger=document.getElementById('burger'),menu=document.getElementById('menu');
  burger.addEventListener('click',()=>{const o=menu.classList.toggle('open');burger.setAttribute('aria-expanded',o)});
  menu.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(a=>a.addEventListener('click',()=>{menu.classList.remove('open');burger.setAttribute('aria-expanded',false)}));
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-player]').forEach(p=>{
    const audio=p.querySelector('audio'),btn=p.querySelector('.pp'),fill=p.querySelector('.pp-fill'),bar=p.querySelector('.pp-bar'),time=p.querySelector('.pp-time');
    const fmt=s=>isNaN(s)?'0:00':Math.floor(s/60)+':'+String(Math.floor(s%60)).padStart(2,'0');
    btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{audio.paused?audio.play().catch(()=>{}):audio.pause()});
    audio.addEventListener('play',()=>btn.textContent='❚❚');
    audio.addEventListener('pause',()=>btn.textContent='▶');
    audio.addEventListener('timeupdate',()=>{if(audio.duration){fill.style.width=(audio.currentTime/audio.duration*100)+'%';time.textContent=fmt(audio.currentTime)}});
    audio.addEventListener('loadedmetadata',()=>time.textContent=fmt(audio.duration));
    audio.addEventListener('ended',()=>{btn.textContent='▶';fill.style.width='0%';time.textContent=fmt(audio.duration)});
    bar.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(!audio.duration)return;const r=bar.getBoundingClientRect();audio.currentTime=((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width)*audio.duration});
  });
</script>
<script>
(function(){
  var slug="thelonnyweb", upcoming=[];
  function esc(s){return (s||'').replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;');}
  function tile(r,tag){
    var y=(r.releaseDate||'').slice(0,4); var has=!!r.cover;
    var bg=has?' style="background-image:url('+r.cover+')"':'';
    var badge=tag?'<span class="rg-badge">'+tag+'</span>':'';
    return '<a class="rg-item'+(tag?' rg-pinned':'')+'" href="'+(r.url||'#')+'" target="_blank" rel="noopener">'
      +'<span class="rg-cover'+(has?'':' mystery')+'"'+bg+'>'+(has?'':'?')+'</span>'
      +'<span class="rg-t">'+esc(r.title)+badge+'</span>'
      +'<span class="rg-y">'+esc(y)+'</span></a>';
  }
  function mysTile(t){return '<span class="rg-item"><span class="rg-cover mystery">?</span><span class="rg-t">'+esc(t)+'</span><span class="rg-y">Upcoming</span></span>';}
  function render(data){
    // data = { official: [], featured: [] } from your Spotify script
    var official=(data&&data.official)||[];
    var featured=(data&&data.featured)||[];
    var html='';
    // 1. latest official release — pinned at top with "Latest" badge
    if(official[0]) html+=tile(official[0],'Latest');
    // 2. rest of official catalog (skip the first which is already shown)
    html+=official.slice(1).map(function(r){return tile(r,null);}).join('');
    // 3. featured appearances — tagged "Featured"
    html+=featured.map(function(r){return tile(r,'Featured');}).join('');
    // 4. upcoming mystery covers at the bottom
    html+=upcoming.map(mysTile).join('');
    if(!html)return;
    var g=document.querySelector('.rel-gallery'); if(!g)return;
    g.innerHTML=html; document.getElementById('rel-gallery').hidden=false;
  }
  fetch('releases.json')
    .then(function(r){return r.json();})
    .then(function(d){render(d.releases&&d.releases[slug]);})
    .catch(function(){render(null);});
})();
</script>
